environmentNotice.label: Notice about this version of the site
environmentNotice.title: Test site ({environment}) — this is not the club's real website.
environmentNotice.body: Everything here is sample data for trying the site out, and it may be deleted at any time. Please do not use it to register for a real event. The club's official website is coming soon, at its own address.

Home.intro: We run together in Brașov. See what is coming up.

Events.intro: Runs, trail outings and training sessions organised by the club.
Events.empty: No events are published right now. Check back soon.
Events.noUpcoming: No upcoming events are scheduled. The club's most recent event:
Events.pastNotice: This event has already taken place.

startList.title: Who's coming
startList.empty: Nobody has confirmed a place yet.
startList.note: Only people who confirmed their registration and did not ask to be left out are listed here.

cta.placesRemaining: {count, plural, one {# place left} other {# places left}}
cta.full: No places left. You can join the waiting list: if one is released, the first person on the list gets it.
cta.closed: Registration has closed for this event.
cta.cancelled: The event has been cancelled, so registration has stopped.

Admin.title: Backoffice
Admin.legalNotice: Legal documents — the privacy notice, the terms and the declaration — are not edited here. New versions arrive through a migration, following the runbook.

registrations.resendSent: The email has been queued again.
registrations.resendNothingToSend: There is nothing to resend for this status.
registrations.newExplanation: For somebody who asked in person, on the phone, or after a run. It enters exactly like a registration the participant made themselves: the same order for places, the same waiting list, the same starting state. They receive the ordinary confirmation email and sign the declaration themselves — nobody can sign one for somebody else.
registrations.noEventsAcceptingRegistrations: No event takes registrations through the platform. Set the registration mode to "Register here" on the event page.
registrations.participantEmailHelp: The confirmation and the declaration link go here. It must be their address, not the club's.
registrations.participantLocale: Language we write to them in
registrations.participantLocaleHelp: The language of every email about this registration.
registrations.listOptOut: They do not want to appear on the public participant list
registrations.relayConfirmation: I confirm this person asked me to register them.
registrations.correctNameHelp: Only the name can be corrected. The email address is the participant's identity and is never changed here: for a wrong address, cancel the registration and add it again with the right one.
registrations.cancelHelp: A registration is never deleted — it records what somebody agreed to and when. Cancelling releases the place, and it goes to the first person on the waiting list.

events.empty: There is no event in the database.

confirm.duplicateBody: A copy is created as a draft, with its own page addresses. It is not featured and it is not published.
confirm.deleteBody: Deleting is permanent. Only an event nobody has registered for can be deleted; for one that has happened, archive it instead.
confirm.archiveBody: The event comes off the site, in both languages. You can bring it back later by sending it through review and publishing it again.
confirm.removeTestBody: Every test registration for this event is deleted, along with the synthetic participants behind them. Real registrations are left untouched.
confirm.cancelRegistrationBody: The place is released immediately and offered to the first person on the waiting list. The registration itself is kept, marked cancelled.

errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: Your role does not allow this.
errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Check what you entered; something is not valid.
errors.CONFLICT: Someone else saved while you were editing. Reload the page and reapply your changes — nothing of yours was overwritten.

editor.startsAtHelp: Local time of the event ({timezone}). For a race this is the gathering time.
editor.raceStartsAtHelp: When the gun goes, if that differs from the gathering time. Leave empty when there is only one time.
editor.mapUrlHelp: Optional. The link is built from the coordinates; fill this in only to point at a specific page. It must start with https://.
editor.featured: Lead the site with this event
editor.featuredHelp: Only one event can be featured. The previously featured one loses the flag automatically.
editor.eventFieldsReadOnly: Only an editor or an administrator can change the times, the map link and the featured event.
editor.translationReadOnly: You cannot edit this text: the event is published, or the text was written by another author.
editor.liveWarning: This event is published. Your changes become public the moment you save.
editor.acknowledgeLive: I understand that I am editing published content.
editor.slugHelp: The page address, in lowercase words joined by hyphens. It can only change before the first publication.
editor.slugLocked: The page has been published, so its address stays as it is.
editor.costHelp: Free text: "Free", "50 lei". Leave empty when no cost has been stated.
editor.coordinatesHelp: The exact start point, in decimal degrees — for example 45.6427 and 25.5887. Right-click the spot on a map to copy them. A park name is not a start line.
editor.sharedFieldHelp: The same in both languages. Filled in once.
editor.contentHelp: The same event, in two languages. Only the words change here; the time, the place, the difficulty and the cost are in Settings above and are shared by both.
editor.noTransitions: Your role cannot move this event from its current state.
editor.incompleteForPublication: Both languages must be complete before this event can be published. Missing: {detail}.
editor.newHelp: Both languages are filled in here, because an event goes live in both at once. Everything else can be changed afterwards on the event's own page.
editor.excerptHelp: One or two sentences. It is what the listing card shows, and it is required before the event can be published.
editor.timezoneHelp: The zone the times below are typed in, e.g. Europe/Bucharest.
editor.endsAtHelp: Optional. Leave empty when the club has stated only a start.
editor.registrationModeHelp: Registration here needs a declaration; registration elsewhere needs the organiser's link.
editor.capacityHelp: Leave empty for unlimited. It cannot be lowered below the places already taken.
editor.registrationWindowHelp: Leave the opening empty and registration opens when the event is published; leave the closing empty and it closes when the event starts.
editor.declarationDocumentHelp: Chosen from the approved versions. This text is never edited here — a new version arrives through a migration.
editor.declarationNone: No approved declaration exists in this environment, so no event can take registrations here yet.
editor.participantList: Publish the participant list on the event page
editor.participantListHelp: Publishes the names of the people who confirmed their registration and did not ask to be left out. No email addresses, and nothing about unconfirmed registrations. This is a disclosure of personal data: the approved privacy notice must describe it before this is switched on.
editor.externalHelp: Both only for an event registered elsewhere. The link must start with https://.
editor.deleteHelp: A duplicate is created as a draft, is never featured, and gets its own page addresses. Deleting is for an event nobody has registered for; archive the ones that happened.

preview.notice: Staff preview. The status of this text is: {status}. This page is not public and is not indexed.

signIn.title: Staff sign-in
signIn.unavailable: Staff sign-in is not available in this environment yet.
signIn.developmentOnly: Development identities, on a local machine and in tests only. These are not real people.

staff.title: Staff
staff.name: Name
staff.inviteHelp: No email is sent: the platform has no sending domain yet. Access begins at their first sign-in with this address.

testRegistrations.title: Test registrations
testRegistrations.explanation: Synthetic participants on reserved @test.invalid addresses, which can never receive mail. They go through the ordinary submission and confirmation path, so they occupy places and fill the waiting list exactly as real people do — and they are left out of the CSV export and labelled everywhere they are listed. Not available in production.

legal.title: Legal documents
legal.intro: The privacy notice, the terms, and the declaration participants sign. Readable here; not editable.
legal.empty: No legal document exists. Registration is refused until an approved privacy notice exists.
legal.immutabilityNotice: A version that has been used cannot be changed: participants signed exactly that text. A change means a new version, loaded through the documented procedure.
legal.readOnlyNotice: This page is read-only. Legal text is not edited from the backoffice.
legal.noTranslations: This version has no text yet.

Legal.unavailable: This document has not been published for this environment yet.

Registration.privacyPrefix: I have read and agree to the

Registration.displayNameHelp: By default the participant list and the results show your full name. If you would rather they showed something else — “Ana P.”, for instance — write it here. To stay off the list entirely, use the option below.
Registration.birthDateHelp: Age categories are worked out against the day of the race.
Registration.healthNotesHelp: Only what an organizer would need to know if you needed help on race day. You may leave this empty.
Registration.healthConsent: I agree that this health information may be kept and used only for my safety on race day
Registration.displayNameToggle: Want to appear publicly under a different name?

Registrations.invalidOrExpired: This link is no longer valid. You can request a new one from the event page.

confirm.done: Your email address has been confirmed.

declare.accept: I have read and accept the declaration above
declare.typedName: Type your full name as a signature
declare.doneWaitlisted: The place was no longer available; you have been added to the waiting list.

manage.eventStarted: This event has already started; the registration can no longer be cancelled.

Devs.title: This deployment's configuration
Devs.intro: What is configured here and what is missing. Variable names and whether they have a value — never the value.
Devs.neverValues: No value, key or secret appears on this page. Only the variable's name and whether it is set.
Devs.runtimeIntro: What the database and the scheduled jobs report at this moment. The same values as /api/health.

overall.limited: Working, but doing less than you probably expect. See the marked items below.
overall.blocked: Something this deployment needs in order to start, or to work, is missing. See the red items below.

emailCaptureLocal.title: Email
emailCaptureLocal.body: Messages are kept in memory and go nowhere. The only mode local and test accept.

emailCaptureDeployed.title: Email
emailCaptureDeployed.body: Messages are kept in memory and go nowhere — and on a hosted environment nobody can read them, because the process is gone. Anyone registering here never receives the confirmation. For real delivery: EMAIL_DELIVERY_MODE=allowlist, together with EMAIL_ALLOWLIST and the three Mailgun variables.

emailAllowlist.title: Email
emailAllowlist.body: Transmits only to the addresses in EMAIL_ALLOWLIST; everything else is captured. Each address must also be an authorized recipient in Mailgun, spelled exactly the same.

emailLive.title: Email
emailLive.body: Transmits to anybody. Permitted in production only.

staffProvider.title: Staff sign-in
staffProvider.body: Through the identity provider. Who may in is still decided by the staff_users table, not by the provider.

staffDevSwitcher.title: Staff sign-in
staffDevSwitcher.body: Development identities, local and test only. Not real people.

staffDisabled.title: Staff sign-in
staffDisabled.body: There is no way in at all: every staff route answers 404. Correct for an environment with no provider configured.

jobs.title: Scheduled jobs
jobs.body: The only thing that drains the email queue and expires holds. Without JOB_SECRET the endpoints refuse every caller, and the symptom is not an error — it is email that never arrives.

webhook.title: Mailgun webhook
webhook.body: How a bounce reaches the registration it belongs to. Without the signing key, requests are refused and delivery state stays unknown.

mapLink.title: Map link
mapLink.body: Optional. Without it the meeting point stays plain text with no link — documented behaviour, not a fault.

Devs.rateLimitsIntro: How many attempts each action accepts, per identity, in a fixed window. A limit somebody is hitting looks like "the site is broken" without anything being broken.
Devs.rolesIntro: Each role can do everything the one below it can, plus one thing more. The line that matters is between Technical and Admin: from there up, participant data is visible.

roleSummary.CONTRIBUTOR: proposes text and submits it for approval
roleSummary.DEV: plus the configuration page. No participant data
roleSummary.ADMIN: plus registrations, participants, exports, deleting an event
roleSummary.SUPERADMIN: plus staff administration: who has access and what they may do
